response.text: {"title": "Our understanding of the College's needs", "text": "The College requires proposals submitted through its procurement portal as a single PDF of no more than 20 pages by 2026-12-01 12:00 UTC [REQ-0001]. The service must integrate with the College's student records system through its existing REST API [REQ-0008] and be live for students by 2027-01-11, the first day of spring enrollment [REQ-0013]. Additionally, the Supplier keeps an audit record of every signature event [REQ-0002], supports signing on current desktop and mobile browsers [REQ-0003], sends a reminder to each signer who has not signed within 72 hours [REQ-0004], provides templates for the College's twelve most used forms [REQ-0005], stores signed documents for ten years [REQ-0006], migrates signed records held in the current tool by 2027-02-28 [REQ-0007], permits an on-premises deployment option [REQ-0009], maintains 99.5% availability in each calendar month excluding planned maintenance announced five working days in advance [REQ-0010], and responds to severity-one incidents within one hour, at any time of day [REQ-0011].", "cited_ids": ["REQ-0001", "REQ-0008", "REQ-0013", "REQ-0002", "REQ-0003", "REQ-0004", "REQ-0005", "REQ-0006", "REQ-0007", "REQ-0009", "REQ-0010", "REQ-0011"]}
